verses.sanskrit:
सञ्जय उवाच।
              तथा तस्मिन् प्रवृत्ते तु सङ्ग्रामे लोमहर्षणे। कौरवेयांस्त्रिधाभूतान् पाण्डवाः समुपाद्रवन् ॥१॥
verses.english: Sanjaya said Thus when that horripilating battle was progressing on, the Pandavas rushed against the Kauravas divided into three bodies.

verses.sanskrit: जलसन्धं महाबाहुं भीमसेनोऽभ्यवर्तत।  युधिष्ठिरः सहानीकः कृतवर्माणमाहवे ॥२॥
किरंस्तु शरवर्षाणि रोचमान इवांशुमान्।  धृष्टद्युम्नो महाराज द्रोणमभ्यद्रवद्रणे ॥३॥
verses.english: Appearing beautiful like the sun and scattering showers of arrows, Dhrishtadyumna, O mighty monarch, rushed upon Drona in that battle.

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रववृते युद्धं त्वरतां सर्वधन्विनाम्।  कुरूणां पाण्डवानां च सङ्क्रुद्धानां परस्परम् ॥४॥
संक्षये तु तथाभूते वर्तमाने महाभये। द्वन्द्वीभूतेषु सैन्येषु युध्यमानेष्वभीतवत् ॥५॥
verses.english: During the progress of that dreadful carnage when the warriors were undauntedly fighting with one another in single combats.

verses.sanskrit: द्रोणः पाञ्चालपुत्रेण बली बलवता सह।  यदक्षिपत् पृषत्कौघांस्तद‌द्भुतमिवाभवत् ॥६॥
verses.english: The mighty Drona fought on with the powerful prince of the Panchalas and the myriads of shafts that he then discharged filled everybody with great wonder.

verses.sanskrit: पुण्डरीकवनानीव विध्वस्तानि समन्ततः।  चक्राते द्रोणपाञ्चाल्यौ नृणां शीर्षाण्यनेकशः ॥७॥
verses.english: Like a forest of lotuses lying torn hither and hither, the heads of princes were being scattered all over the field by Drona and the prince of the Panchalas.

verses.sanskrit: विनिकीर्णानि वीराणामनीकेषु समन्ततः।  वस्त्राभरणशस्त्राणि ध्वजवर्मायुधानि च ॥८॥
तपनीयतनुत्राणाः संसिक्ता रुधिरेण च।  संसक्ता इव दृश्यन्ते मेघसङ्घाः सविद्युतः ॥९॥
verses.english: Golden arınours bespattered with blood, looked like masses of clouds illumined with flashes of lightning.

verses.sanskrit: कुञ्जराश्वनरानन्ये पातयन्ति स्म पत्रिभिः। तालमात्राणि चापानि विकर्षन्तो महारथाः ॥१०॥
verses.english: Other mighty car-warriors, stretching their bows full six cubits long, felled with their winged shafts numerous elephants, steeds and men.

verses.sanskrit: असिचर्माणि चापानि शिरांसि कवचानि च।  विप्रकीर्यन्त शूराणां सम्प्रहारे महात्मनाम् ॥११॥
verses.english: In that battle between illustrious combatants, many swords, bucklers, bows, heads and armours of heroes, were seen lying scattered all over the field.

verses.sanskrit: उत्थितान्यगणेयानि कबन्धानि समन्ततः। अदृश्यन्त महाराज तस्मिन् परमसङ्कुले ॥१२॥
गृध्राः कङ्का बकाः श्येना वायसा जम्बुकास्तथा।  बहुशः पिशिताशाश्च तत्रादृश्यन्त मारिष ॥१३॥
verses.english: Vultures and Kankas and crows and jackals and numerous other flesh-eating animals, were seen there, O sire.

verses.sanskrit: भक्षयन्तश्च मांसानि पिबन्तश्चापि शोणितम्। विलुम्पन्तश्च केशांश्च मज्जाश्च बहुधा नृप ॥१४॥
verses.english: Eating flesh, drinking blood, dragging the hair and pecking the marrow.

verses.sanskrit: आकर्षन्तः शरीराणि शरीरावयवांस्तथा। नराश्वगजसङ्घानां शिरांसि च ततस्ततः ॥१५॥
verses.english: And dragging out the bodies and limbs and heads, O king, of slain men, steeds, elephants.

verses.sanskrit: कृतास्त्रा रणदीक्षाभिर्दीक्षिता रणशालिनः। रणे जयं प्रार्थयाना भृशं युयुधिरे तदा ॥१६॥
verses.english: Accomplished in the use of weapons, skilled in fighting and firmly resolved to fight, warriors exerted themselves vigorously in the battle, desirous of winning fame only.

verses.sanskrit: असिमार्गान् बहुविधान् विचेरुः सैनिका रण।  ऋष्टिभिः शक्तिभिः प्रासैः शूल तोमरपट्टिशैः ॥१७॥
verses.english: The soldiers then roamed over the field, performing various evolutionary movements performed by swords-men. With darts, lances, javelins, tridents, tomaras and battle axes.

verses.sanskrit: गदाभिः परिघैश्चान्यैरायुधश्च भुजैरपि।  अन्योन्यं जघ्निरे क्रुद्धा युद्धरङ्गगता नराः ॥१८॥
रथिनो रथिभिः सार्धमश्वारोहाश्च सादिभिः। मातङ्गा वरमातङ्गैः पदाताश्च पदातिभिः ॥१९॥
verses.english: Car-warriors became engaged with carwarriors, cavalry soldiers with cavalry-soldiers, elephants with other excellent elephants and infantry with infantry.

verses.sanskrit: क्षीबा इवान्ये चोन्मत्ता रङ्गेष्विव च वारणाः। उच्चुक्रुशुरथान्योन्यं जघ्नुरन्योन्यमेव च ॥२०॥
verses.english: Many infuriate elephants as if perfectly mad, uttered loud shrieks and killed one another, after the manner they do so in arenas of sport.

verses.sanskrit: वर्तमान तथा युद्धे निर्मर्यादे विशाम्पते।  धृष्टद्युम्नो हयानश्वैर्द्रोणस्य व्यत्यमिश्रयत् ॥२१॥
verses.english: O ruler of men, as that battle, in which none paid any regard to any one, raged, Dhrishtadyumna caused his own horses to be entangled with those of Drona.

verses.sanskrit: ते हयाः साध्वशोभन्त मिश्रिता वातरंहसः। पारावतसवर्णाश्च रक्तशोणाश्च संयुगे ॥२२॥
verses.english: Those pegion-white and crimson steeds, endued with the fleetness of the wind, appeared extremely beautiful, being mingled together in that battle.

verses.sanskrit: पारावतसवर्णास्ते रक्तशोणविमिश्रिताः।  हयाः शुशुभिरे राजन् मेघा इव सविद्युतः ॥२३॥
verses.english: The horses, O king, then shone like clouds surcharged with lightning. Then Dhrishtadyumna beholding Drona approach him.

verses.sanskrit: धृष्टद्युम्नस्तु संम्प्रेक्ष्य द्रोणमभ्याशमागतम्।  असिचर्माऽऽदद वीरो धनुरुत्सृज्य भारत ॥२४॥
verses.english: Grasped his sword and mace and that hero, O Bharata, left aside his bow. Then that slayer of hostile heroes viz., Prishatas son, desirous of achieving a difficult feat.

verses.sanskrit: चिकीर्षुर्दुष्करं कर्म पार्षतः परवीरहा। ईषया समतिक्रम्य द्रोणस्य रथमाविशत् ॥२५॥
verses.english: Leap over the shafts of Drona's car and entered into it. He then stood sometimes on the yoke and sometimes on its joints.

verses.sanskrit: अतिष्ठद्युगमध्ये स युगसन्नहनेषु च। जघानार्धेषु चाश्वानां तत्सैन्यान्यभ्यपूजयन् ॥२६॥
खड्गेन चरतस्तस्य शोणाश्वानधितिष्ठतः।  न ददर्शान्तरं द्रोणस्तदद्भुतमिवाभवत् ॥२७॥
यथा श्येनस्य पतनं वनेष्वामिषगृद्धिनः।  तथैवासीदभीसारस्तस्य द्रोणं जिघांसतः ॥२८॥
verses.english: Looked that sally of Dhrishtadyumna from his own chariot, upon Drona, for his slaughter, Thereafter with a hundred shafts Drona cut-off the shield of Drupada's son, decked with hundred moons and then with another ten he cut-off nis sword.

verses.sanskrit: ततः शरशतेनास्य शतचन्द्रं समाक्षिपत्। द्रोणो द्रुपदपुत्रस्य खड्गं च दशभिः शरैः ॥२९॥
हयांश्चैव चतुःषष्ट्या शराणां जघ्निवान् बली।  ध्वजं छत्रं च भल्लाभ्यां तथा तौ पार्ष्णिसारथी ॥३०॥
अथास्मै त्वरितो बाणमपरं जीवितान्तकम्। आकर्णपूर्णं चिक्षेप वज्रं वज्रधरो यथा ॥३१॥
verses.english: Having at first drawn the bow-string back to the very ears, like Indra hurling the thunderbolt.

verses.sanskrit: तं चतुर्दशभिस्तीक्ष्णैर्बाणैश्चिच्छेद सात्यकिः। ग्रस्तमाचार्यमुख्येन धृष्टद्युम्नं व्यमोचयत् ॥३२॥
verses.english: Then again with great lightness of hands, he sped at Dhrishtadyumna an arrow capable of destroying his life, but soon Satyaki, with fourteen arrows of great sharpness, cut-off that fatal shaft shot by Drona.

verses.sanskrit: सिंहेनेव मृगं ग्रस्तं नरसिंहेन मारिष। द्रोणेन मोचयामास पाञ्चाल्यं शिनिपुङ्गवः ॥३३॥
verses.english: Thus, 0 sire, Satyaki rescued Dhrishtadyumna, who had been seized by that foremost of the preceptor, that best of men, like a deer seized by a lion.

verses.sanskrit: सात्यकिं प्रेक्ष्य गोप्तारं पाञ्चाल्यं च महाहवे। शराणां त्वरतो द्रोणः षड्विंशत्या समार्पयत् ॥३४॥
verses.english: That foremost descendant of Sini then rescued the prince of the Panchalas from Drona. Beholding Satyaki save the Panchala prince in that battle. Drona quickly sped at him twenty-six arrows.

verses.sanskrit: ततो द्रोणं शिनेः पौत्रो ग्रसन्तमपि सृञ्जयान्। प्रत्यविध्यच्छितैर्बाणैः षड्विंशत्या स्तनान्तरे ॥३५॥
ततः सर्वे रथास्तूर्ण पाञ्चाल्या जयगृद्धिनः।  सात्वताभिसृते द्रोणे धृष्टद्युम्नमवाक्षिपन् ॥३६॥
verses.english: Then, upon the Satvata hero Satyaki advancing upon Drona, all the Panchala carwarriors, desirous of victory, extricated Dhrishtadyumna from that encounter.
